title: Turn-start capture under test: the cleanup flush and the capture each get a full deadlock guard, and only the capture asserts an overrun
outcome: In record_engram_turn_start_basis_and_snapshot_off_lock (src/engram_turn_observations.rs), production shares one REVIEW_FREEZE_TIMEOUT deadline across the root-cleanup flush and the basis capture. Under the cfg(test) turn-start capture clock, each phase now gets its own TEST_PHASE_DEADLOCK_GUARD (60 s), and only the capture panics past it. A stuck fixture can therefore wait about 120 s, and a stuck test-transport flush falls through silently. Either give both phases one shared guard deadline in tests, or assert a flush overrun too, so a stuck flush fails as fast as a stuck capture. There is no production impact.
acceptance: Turn-start capture under test: the cleanup flush and the capture each get a full deadlock guard, and only the capture asserts an overrun is done
